<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/test_data/reset"}
#docs
Puts a test business back to how a new test mode of its live business starts. Deletes the customers and every subscription, invoice, payment and credit note, the catalog, coupons, taxes, dunning, webhook endpoints, gateways and email settings, and stops Time Travel. Copies the settings of the live business again, adds a new TM Test Gateway and starts the document numbers again at 1. The business id stays the same, so test keys and a stored business id keep working. Team members, API keys and the audit log are kept. A test business without a live business cannot be reset.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `test_data_reset`. One of `test_data_reset`. |
| `business` | `string` | The id of the business that was reset (biz_…). |
| `deleted` | `integer` | Number of rows deleted. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The business was reset |
| `400` | The business is a live business, or has no live business |
| `403` | A live key cannot use the test tools |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/test_data/reset" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)"
```
